system.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Restoration (EC16)

ACTION • Burn 3 • USES 1 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: Touch; self or adjacent / One living willing creature

Effect: Restore the target’s most severe currently marked Core Wound and remove its corresponding Wound Condition. Follow the normal reverse-order recovery rule. A creature can benefit from Restoration only once per Adventure, even from different copies. This cannot revive the dead or recreate a missing limb or organ.

Design note: Exceptional healing, not a consumable-kit baseline. If a Wound represents an injury this Function cannot repair, it cannot restore that Wound.

Major treasure; not assumed starting equipment. This is the only Function here that restores a Core Wound.
system.flavor: A deliberately exceptional example of genuine healing.
